subcommands.name: describe-report-creation
subcommands.description: Describes the status of the StartReportCreation operation.

subcommands.name: get-compliance-summary
subcommands.description: Returns a table that shows counts of resources that are noncompliant with their tag policies.

subcommands.name: get-resources
subcommands.description: Returns all the tagged or previously tagged resources that are located in the specified Amazon Web Services Region for the account.

subcommands.name: get-tag-keys
subcommands.description: Returns all tag keys currently in use in the specified Amazon Web Services Region for the calling account.

subcommands.name: get-tag-values
subcommands.description: Returns all tag values for the specified key that are used in the specified Amazon Web Services Region for the calling account.

subcommands.name: list-required-tags
subcommands.description: Lists the required tags for supported resource types in an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: start-report-creation
subcommands.description: Generates a report that lists all tagged resources in the accounts across your organization and tells whether each resource is compliant with the effective tag policy.

subcommands.name: tag-resources
subcommands.description: Applies one or more tags to the specified resources.

subcommands.name: untag-resources
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the specified resources.
